theorem: This fixed total language is in P and NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in pinned full B2, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^9*(log2(log2 N))^7. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^9*(log2(log2 N))^(7+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(9+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. One fixed ordinary header S0 gives hardness. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P=O_S0(L^2*(ceil(log2 L))^2)=o(k), including the four internal growing-dimension packages. The supplied finite4n-8d theorem covers all16 B2 tables, constants and sharing. The robust moment proof needs O(r^2*u) independence and log-error. Layout loses only a factor2^O_S0(log r), preserving actual bad-coordinate accounting. No numerical B, efficient search for S0 or unpaid weak-design construction is assumed. For common admitted scalar plans define P_full=P+sum_internal(D_int^2-D_int)*s and P_paid=P_full+122*s0+1001*w+17*s2. C2 reduces exact4*P_full+8*k by4*sum_internal(D_int^2-D_int)*s; C1 additionally accounts for the stated canonical saving. Both preserve9,7 asymptotics.
